annotations.title: Hyperliquid funding extremes and open-interest movers (z-score vs each coin's own 7 days)

description: Use when hunting crowded perps: which markets have funding far from their own normal and where open interest is jumping. Input: optional limit (1-50, default 10), min_oi_usd (default 1,000,000). Output: as_of, fundingExtremes ranked by |z| (current 1h funding vs the coin's last 7 days), oiMovers24h and oiMovers1h (open-interest % change), each with funding APR and OI USD. Behavior: markets below min_oi_usd are skipped; z compares the current hourly funding with the coin's own last 7 days, so a high absolute rate can rank low (absolute ranking: hl_funding_screener). OI change is vs our snapshots 1 h and 24 h earlier. Cached 5 min. Use instead: hl_funding_screener for absolute funding ranking with filters; hl_funding_history for one coin's history. Example: ?limit=10 Price: $0.006 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

min_oi_usd.description: Skip markets with open interest below this many USD (default 1,000,000)
